decisive_items: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia
response.rationale: The histopathologic examination reveals characteristic features of onychopapilloma, including bland spindle cell proliferation and villous fibroepithelial projections, which are not typical of melanonychia or onychomatricoma.

rejected.why: No melanocytic lesions observed and immunostaining negative for S100 and CD34, contradicting melanonychia diagnosis
While onychomatricoma shares some clinical features, the histopathologic examination is more characteristic of onychopapilloma
